review.headline: Tempo session executed as prescribed: 4 km held at 4:37/km with easy warm-up and cool-down.
observations: Tempo block: 4.0 km in 1108 s at 4:37/km, matching the 4:37/km target; km splits 4:36-4:37 were very even.
Warm-up and cool-down ran at 5:45/km, inside the 5:11-6:13/km easy band, with HR around 135-140 bpm, so the easy portions were controlled.
Tempo HR averaged 161-162 bpm (session avg 148, max 165), a firm but sustainable effort for a threshold block.
Total 8.0 km in 2488 s, average 5:11/km, with about 20 m of elevation gain.
flags: No RPE or athlete note was logged, so the subjective effort is unknown.
No runs are recorded after 2026-11-03 in the metrics window to 2026-11-25, and week 1 completed 8.0 of 42.0 planned km.
CTL fell 4.7 points over 7 days (to 25.7 from 43.7 on the session date), and weekly running averaged 2.0 km over the last 4 weeks.
Strength and cross-training sessions are also logged as 0 completed across all weeks so far.
